messages:
Maria (CS): quick heads-up — Badger onboarding flagged. They want SLA confirmation before sign-off. Need uptime % and latency P95 math + credit calc. cc @Elena :eyes:
Raj (SRE): got it. what exact P95 did AE commit to? our template is 250ms, contract may say 200ms for /query route.
Elena (AE): Badger insists on 200ms P95 for `POST /v1/query`. That's a renewal gating item.
Maria (CS): they saw a 1.2s tail during the sandbox run yesterday. If we can't reconcile, renewal sentiment drops. @Raj can you pull 30d P95 and outage windows? :pray:
Raj (SRE): pulling now. quick Prom like query I usually run: ```promql
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(request_latency_bucket{service="badger-prod",route="/v1/query"}[5m])) by (le))
```
Raj (SRE): early result — 30d P95 ~ 230ms, but there are three spikes around 11/28 that pushed it up. uptime (last 30d) = 99.87% per our monitor. OpsBot will drop the evidence bundle.
OpsBot: generated uptime & incident summary for `badger-prod` (30d). files: uptime_report_30d.csv, incidents_30d.json, traces_11-28.zip. link: https://internal/reports/badger/1719876543
Maria (CS): rough credit calc: contract SLO 99.9% -> observed 99.87% = 0.03% shortfall. Policy: 0.1% shortfall => 1% monthly credit (capped). so 0.03% -> prorated ~0.3% credit. I'll propose 0.5% as goodwill if they accept a follow-up enablement session.
Elena (AE): Badger asked for 1% up front. I'll push for 0.5% + enablement. If we give 0.3% they'd be upset.
Raj (SRE): technical ask — need the exact trace IDs from the 11/28 spikes before we commit to root cause. I attached traces_11-28.zip. Also suggest we enable KV cache on that route to reduce tail.
Maria (CS): action list: 1) Raj attach cleaned P95 CSV + traces (due today) 2) I will draft the SLA evidence email + credit calc (due EOD) 3) Elena to confirm customer's appetite for enablement + 0.5% counter (sync by tomorrow).
Elena (AE): scheduling note — customer preferred 12/12 10am PT for the follow-up. I can own the invite once Maria shares the one-pager. :calendar:
Raj (SRE): noted. will add brief runbook snippet for on-call in the one-pager: ```
- run `svc tail badger-prod --route /v1/query` to surface hot paths
- check cache-hit rate: `metric cache_hits / cache_lookups`
- increase prefix cache TTL to 30s for high-card routes
```
Maria (CS): thanks team. I'll send draft to this thread before EOD for quick review. If we land 0.5% + enablement, mark account health as "at-risk -> mitigated" in Salesforce. :+1:
Elena (AE): ack. I can escalate renewal flag to renewal_ops if they push back.
Raj (SRE): attaching final CSV now.
Maria (CS): received CSV + traces. Drafting email. Will post final text here for sign-off.
Maria (CS): (later) draft posted — "Attached: uptime_report_30d, incidents_30d, traces_11-28. Our calculation shows a 0.3% contractual credit; we propose 0.5% with a technical enablement session on 12/12 to address tail latency and caching. Please confirm if acceptable."
Elena (AE): looks good, small edit to add escalation contact. LGTM. :+1:
Maria (CS): sending to Badger now. closing thread after customer ack.
